name: Koe Interpreters
description: Koe Interpreters — a landing theme for a conference interpreting agency. A film-grain booth photograph behind a slanted navy scrim with three slanted photo columns bleeding off the right, a phrase marquee with photo capsules and a white sheet with rounded top corners that rides over the hero, nine tilted language-pair cards on a teal-to-amber band, an hour ruler for the meeting day and a plain rates table. Fraunces for headings, Newsreader for reading. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German.

fonts.role: display: headings, wordmark, marquee, prices (variable, Latin subset)
text: body copy, navigation, labels and small print (variable roman and italic, Latin subset)

summary: A conference interpreting agency: a pinned photo hero with slanted photo columns, a rounded white sheet, tilted language-pair cards and one request button.
